test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

My cousin, Jawahar, / visited me at home / and asked me / what I am reading.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **what l am reading **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Use '**was**' in place of '<stro
